skillCopy.links.notCopied.text: {n, plural, =1 {the link {paths} is} other {the links {paths} are}} missing from its copy: Windows didn't let Hive make {n, plural, =1 {it} other {them}} (a link to a file needs a privilege)
skillCopy.links.notCopied.note: What a skill's links that couldn't be copied mean for the session that gets it. paths: the links' paths, joined with commas; n: how many.

skillCopy.source.denied.text: its folder in the workspace could not be read (access denied)
skillCopy.source.denied.note: A skill delivery's problem: Windows refused to read the skill's folder in the workspace.

skillCopy.source.fileWent.text: a file in it went while it was being copied
skillCopy.source.fileWent.note: A skill delivery's problem: a file of the skill's folder in the workspace went while Hive copied it.

skillCopy.source.folderGone.text: its folder in the workspace is gone
skillCopy.source.folderGone.note: A skill delivery's problem: the skill's folder in the workspace is gone.

skillCopy.source.notCopied.text: it could not be copied{hasCode, select, yes { ({code})} other {}}
skillCopy.source.notCopied.note: A skill delivery's problem: making its copy failed (a disk full, a write that failed). hasCode: yes with the error's code (code: ENOSPC…).

skillCopy.swap.changedBeforeRemoved.text: {name} changed before it could be removed
skillCopy.swap.changedBeforeRemoved.note: Why a removal was abandoned: it was edited before Hive removed it. Nothing was removed.

skillCopy.swap.changedBeforeReplaced.text: {name} changed before it could be replaced
skillCopy.swap.changedBeforeReplaced.note: Why a swap was abandoned (a skill's or mode's copy; name: its folder or file name): it was edited before Hive replaced it. Nothing was replaced.

skillCopy.swap.changedKeptBeside.text: {name} changed while it was being replaced; the edited copy is kept beside it
skillCopy.swap.changedKeptBeside.note: Why a swap was abandoned: it was edited while Hive replaced it; the edited copy is kept beside it as a -conflict- copy.

skillCopy.swap.changedWhileRemoved.text: {name} changed while it was being removed
skillCopy.swap.changedWhileRemoved.note: Why a removal was abandoned: it was edited while Hive removed it, and was put back (or kept as a -conflict- copy).

skillCopy.swap.changedWhileReplaced.text: {name} changed while it was being replaced
skillCopy.swap.changedWhileReplaced.note: Why a swap was abandoned: it was edited while Hive replaced it, and was put back as it was.

skillCopy.swap.putBackWhileReplaced.text: {name} was put back while it was being replaced
skillCopy.swap.putBackWhileReplaced.note: Why a swap was abandoned: something new took its place while Hive replaced it.

skillCopy.tooBig.bytes.note: Why a skill or mode is too big for Hive to check (HASH_LIMITS): mb is the limit in MB, a whole number. A delivery's problem and a kept revision's reason.

skillCopy.tooBig.deliver.text: it is too big for Hive to check ({why})
skillCopy.tooBig.deliver.note: A launch's problem for a skill over HASH_LIMITS: why is one of skillCopy.tooBig.*.

skillCopy.tooBig.depth.text: it has folders more than {depth} deep
skillCopy.tooBig.depth.note: Why a skill or mode is too big for Hive to check (HASH_LIMITS): depth is the most folder levels.

skillCopy.tooBig.entries.text: it has more than {entries} files and folders
skillCopy.tooBig.entries.note: Why a skill or mode is too big for Hive to check (HASH_LIMITS): entries is the most files and folders.
